description: GigaPOWERS is Aramco’s Parallel Oil Water Gas Enhanced Reservoir Simulator. The provider describes version 9 deployment for reservoir management and carbon-storage capacity and injection studies. The provider is Saudi Aramco Strategic Modeling Technology. Coverage: The internal model is configured for Aramco reservoir and aquifer studies. The reviewed announcement is dated August 2023; scenario horizons can extend beyond operational production periods. Access: The public company account identifies internal development, deployment and user applications. External code access or licensing was not established. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Very large model sizes and runtimes are provider claims, not independent benchmarks. A future version mentioned in the 2023 article was not checked. For simulation it identifies a maintained reservoir and carbon-storage modelling system. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly identifies GigaPOWERS.
